files.author: Bilig
modifications: authored by the pipeline script, no third-party geometry or textures: built in metres around the carina, scaled x7 (about 3.8 scene units tall); the body faces +z, so _L (subject's left) is +x

node names are the content contract: Nose (external nose, nasal cavity with conchae), Larynx (thyroid and cricoid cartilages, arytenoids, epiglottis), Trachea (18 C-shaped cartilage rings open at the back), Bronchi_L/R (main and lobar bronchi, ringed), Bronchioles_L/R, Lung_L (upper and lower lobe, cardiac notch) and Lung_R (upper, middle, lower lobe) semi-translucent, Alveoli_1…Alveoli_9 (magnified cluster beside the right lung, each with its capillary net; one cut open), Diaphragm (two cupolae, trefoil central tendon, crura), Ribs (ribs 1–10 back and sides only, thoracic spine; translucent)

decorative nodes bound to no concept: Pharynx, Alveolar_Duct (terminal bronchiole, alveolar ducts, pulmonary arteriole and venule), Zoom_Callout (translucent cone and rings from the right lung to the cluster)

lobes: one lung field (apex, diaphragm-shaped base, mediastinal surface, heart impression) cut by oblique / horizontal fissure planes with a thin gap, meshed by surface nets and simplified with meshoptimizer; the bronchiole tree grows by recursive splitting of each lobe volume (branch to the centroid of its share, split along the principal axis), so it fills every lobe

look: pink wet pleura with a faint lobule pattern and clearcoat, cream cartilaginous airways grading to coral small bronchioles, blue-white hyaline cartilage, capillaries graded blue (arteriole side) to red (venule side), red-brown diaphragm muscle with a white tendon
deterministic (mulberry32 / seeded gradient noise): a rebuild gives the same bytes
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation; KHR_materials_clearcoat, KHR_materials_sheen, KHR_texture_transform
